note: One row per WRF single-moment WSM-family scheme the engine runs through gpuwm/core/wsm_family.py. A row is the whole admission of the scheme's column kernel: unit and entry points, kernel argument order of the mass species, precipitating classes with surface accumulators, compiled level tiers, and the frozen WRF words file.

declared_divergences.what: The PLM sedimentation remap (nislfv_rain_plm/plm6 find_kt) searches every arrival interface and the column top, so kt never falls below kb.
declared_divergences.wrf: WRF's search stops one interface short; a target layer whose top lies above every interface it tests falls through to kt = kb - 1 and its share of the arriving mass is dropped (the same search WSM6 and WDM6 carry, queue 073).
declared_divergences.cause: a WRF search-bound defect: mass is deleted from the column instead of being remapped

declared_divergences.what: REFL_10CM adds hail's dry-ice Rayleigh term (WSM7's own hail PSD: n0h 4e4 m-4, density 912 kg m-3, m = am D^3, mu = 0).
declared_divergences.wrf: refl10cm_wsm7 sums rain, snow and graupel only, so a hail core does not appear in the diagnostic.
declared_divergences.cause: a WRF omission: the seventh class is left out of the reflectivity diagnostic

local_frame_provenance.basis: production loader, both arithmetic modes; driver local-size attribute
